note: Hawaii prints no aye list, so the fetcher counts every sitting member not named as a no or excused as an aye. This file says who was NOT sitting on a date. The House prints no aye count, so a vacancy is invisible in its text and must come from an official source.

windows.note: Rep. Gene Ward, HD-018. Retirement effective March 31, 2025 (Governor's May 28, 2025 release naming his successor: 'His retirement was effective March 31'); he died April 4, 2025. Every House floor vote from April 1 to sine die was taken with 50 members.

vacancies.note: Vacant from Ward's retirement until Joe Gedeon was appointed (announced May 28, 2025) and sworn in, after the 2025 session had adjourned; no 2025 floor vote falls after the appointment.
